notes: Captured page is gumroad.com/about (the site's brand/story page), which is what the URL resolved to. Type scale normalized from computed px (14/16/18/20/24/36/48/72/96) to rem; the raw profile's 13.33px, 30px and 192px are one-off outliers (form controls, a single oversized numeral) and were dropped. Weight 500 is declared in markup but no 500 face is served — only 400 and 700 woff2 — so it renders as 400; listed anyway because the design system intends it. Tracking is a single global -0.4px at every size, not a proportional ramp (see the exemplar's type note). radius 9999px stands in for the raw profile's 3.35544e+07px (browser clamp of a huge value) and for the site's own --border-radius-3: 10rem pill token. Shadows have ZERO blur by design — every entry is offset + spread 0; the raw profile's craft.elevation.shadows came back empty because it only looks for blurred shadows, which is itself the finding. color.dark filled from craft.theme.dark (a real prefers-color-scheme re-theme); its reported accent 'rgba(0,0,0,0)' is a sampling artifact — the pink accent is unchanged in dark mode, per the stylesheet. The motion probe classified the two tag-marquee rows as 'transform/parallax @ scroll-progress'; they are time-based linear-infinite loops, so they are recorded under techniques, not scroll_effects. The 11 scroll frames are pixel-identical to s00 (capture never scrolled) and were not usable as motion evidence; motion is grounded in the stylesheet's @keyframes + prefers-reduced-motion blocks and the inline hero-parallax script.
